name: Can I stay in my house if it has storm damage?

mainEntity.name: Can I stay in my house if it has storm damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can safely stay in your house after storm damage depends on the severity and nature of the damage. If there's structural compromise, a gas leak, significant electrical issues, or extensive flooding, it is generally unsafe to remain. Even if the damage seems minor, hidden issues like a compromised roof, water in ceilings, or potential mold growth can pose risks. Always prioritize safety. If you're unsure, consult with emergency services or a professional restoration company who can assess the dwelling's safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: Staying in a storm-damaged house depends on severity; structural compromise, gas leaks, electrical issues, or extensive flooding usually require evacuation.
